@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _Migration:
    version: int
    name: str
    path: Path
    text: str
    sha256: str


def open_connection(path: str | Path, *, read_only: bool = False) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Open a configured SQLite connection for an operational database."""
    database_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
    if read_only:
        uri = f"{database_path.as_uri()}?mode=ro"
        conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True, isolation_level=None)
        try:
            conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
            conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
            conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")
        except BaseException:
            conn.close()
            raise
        return conn

    conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path, isolation_level=None)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
        mode = str(conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL").fetchone()[0]).lower()
        if mode != "wal":
            raise PersistenceError(f"SQLite refused WAL mode for {database_path}: {mode!r}")
        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = FULL")
        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
    except BaseException:
        conn.close()
        raise
    return conn


def discover_migrations(migrations_dir: str | Path | None = None) -> tuple[_Migration, ...]:
    """Read a complete, consecutively numbered set of forward migrations."""
    directory = (
        Path(migrations_dir)
        if migrations_dir is not None
        else Path(__file__).parent / "migrations"
    )
    discovered: list[_Migration] = []
    versions: set[int] = set()
    paths = directory.iterdir() if directory.is_dir() else ()
    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda item: item.name):
        match = _MIGRATION_RE.fullmatch(path.name)
        if match is None or not path.is_file():
            continue
        version = int(match.group("version"))
        if version in versions:
            raise PersistenceError(f"duplicate migration version {version:04d} in {directory}")
        versions.add(version)
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        discovered.append(
            _Migration(
                version=version,
                name=match.group("name"),
                path=path,
                text=text,
                sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
            )
        )
    discovered.sort(key=lambda migration: migration.version)
    actual = [migration.version for migration in discovered]
    expected = list(range(1, len(discovered) + 1))
    if actual != expected:
        raise PersistenceError(
            f"migration versions must be consecutive starting at 0001; found {actual}"
        )
    return tuple(discovered)


def _schema_migrations_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> bool:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'schema_migrations'"
    ).fetchone()
    return row is not None


def current_schema_version(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
    """Return the greatest applied migration version, or zero for a fresh DB."""
    if not _schema_migrations_exists(conn):
        return 0
    row = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations").fetchone()
    return int(row[0])


def _migration_statements(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Split SQL without losing trigger bodies; unlike executescript, do not commit."""
    statements: list[str] = []
    buffer = ""
    for character in text:
        buffer += character
        if character == ";" and sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
            if buffer.strip():
                statements.append(buffer)
            buffer = ""
    remaining_lines = (line for line in buffer.splitlines() if line.strip())
    if buffer.strip() and not all(line.lstrip().startswith("--") for line in remaining_lines):
        if not sqlite3.complete_statement(buffer):
            raise sqlite3.OperationalError("incomplete SQL at end of migration")
        statements.append(buffer)
    return tuple(statements)

def _require_utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)


def _require_nonempty(value: str, name: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")
    return value.strip()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class HealthSnapshot:
    """One immutable engine heartbeat.

    ``sequence`` is a monotonic counter assigned by the engine.  ``feed_freshness``
    is one of ``FRESH`` / ``STALE`` / ``UNKNOWN``.  ``scheduler_status``,
    ``reconciliation_status`` and ``protective_stop_status`` are short opaque
    status strings supplied by those components.  Pool depth and backpressure
    counters plus the router backlog expose saturation for DEGRADED decisions.
    """

    state: EngineState
    mode: EngineMode
    account_scope_id: str
    heartbeat_at: datetime
    sequence: int
    entries_allowed: bool
    entry_block_reasons: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    feed_freshness: str = "UNKNOWN"
    scheduler_status: str = "UNKNOWN"
    pool_depth: int = 0
    pool_backpressure: int = 0
    pool_overflow: int = 0
    router_backlog: int = 0
    reconciliation_status: str = "UNKNOWN"
    protective_stop_status: str = "UNKNOWN"
    last_error: str | None = field(default=None)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.state, EngineState):
            raise ValueError(f"state must be EngineState; got {type(self.state).__name__}")
        if not isinstance(self.mode, EngineMode):
            raise ValueError(f"mode must be EngineMode; got {type(self.mode).__name__}")
        object.__setattr__(
            self, "account_scope_id", _require_nonempty(self.account_scope_id, "account_scope_id")
        )
        object.__setattr__(self, "heartbeat_at", _require_utc(self.heartbeat_at, "heartbeat_at"))
        if isinstance(self.sequence, bool) or not isinstance(self.sequence, int):
            raise ValueError("sequence must be an integer")
        if self.sequence < 0:
            raise ValueError("sequence must be non-negative")
        if not isinstance(self.entries_allowed, bool):
            raise ValueError("entries_allowed must be bool")
        if not isinstance(self.entry_block_reasons, tuple) or any(
            not isinstance(reason, str) or not reason.strip()
            for reason in self.entry_block_reasons
        ):
            raise ValueError("entry_block_reasons must be a tuple of non-empty strings")
        object.__setattr__(
            self, "entry_block_reasons", tuple(r.strip() for r in self.entry_block_reasons)
        )
        for name in ("feed_freshness", "scheduler_status", "reconciliation_status",
                     "protective_stop_status"):
            value = getattr(self, name)
            if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")
        for name in ("pool_depth", "pool_backpressure", "pool_overflow", "router_backlog"):
            value = getattr(self, name)
            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0:
                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-negative integer")
        if self.last_error is not None and not isinstance(self.last_error, str):
            raise ValueError("last_error must be str or None")


class HealthSink(Protocol):
    """Port that receives heartbeats (for example the persistence writer)."""

    def publish(self, snapshot: HealthSnapshot) -> object:
        """Receive one heartbeat; may return an awaitable."""
        ...


def classify_liveness(
    snapshot: HealthSnapshot | None,
    now: datetime,
    max_heartbeat_age: timedelta,
) -> Liveness:
    """Classify liveness purely from heartbeat age.

    Thresholds (documented for dashboard reuse):

    * ``OFFLINE`` when there is no snapshot, no heartbeat timestamp, or the
      heartbeat age is strictly greater than ``2 * max_heartbeat_age``.
    * ``STALE`` when the age is strictly greater than ``max_heartbeat_age``
      but within twice it.
    * ``ONLINE`` otherwise (age at or under the threshold; future heartbeats
      count as fresh).

    Pure function of ``(snapshot, now, max_heartbeat_age)``; it performs no
    I/O and consults no engine state.
    """

    current = _require_utc(now, "now")
    if not isinstance(max_heartbeat_age, timedelta) or max_heartbeat_age <= timedelta(0):
        raise ValueError("max_heartbeat_age must be a positive timedelta")
    if snapshot is None or not isinstance(snapshot, HealthSnapshot):
        return Liveness.OFFLINE
    heartbeat = snapshot.heartbeat_at
    if not isinstance(heartbeat, datetime) or heartbeat.tzinfo is None:
        return Liveness.OFFLINE
    age = current - heartbeat.astimezone(UTC)
    if age <= timedelta(0):
        return Liveness.ONLINE
    if age <= max_heartbeat_age:
        return Liveness.ONLINE
    if age <= max_heartbeat_age * 2:
        return Liveness.STALE
    return Liveness.OFFLINE

    @property
    def unsafe_flags(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Names of broker restrictions that block new entries."""
        return tuple(
            name
            for name in ("trading_blocked", "account_blocked", "trade_suspended_by_user")
            if getattr(self, name)
        )

class HealthSnapshot:
    component: str
    status: HealthStatus
    observed_at: datetime
    heartbeat_at: datetime | None = None
    details: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        _require_nonempty(self.component, "component")
        if not isinstance(self.status, HealthStatus):
            raise TypeError("status must be a HealthStatus")
        _require_utc(self.observed_at, "observed_at")
        if self.heartbeat_at is not None:
            _require_utc(self.heartbeat_at, "heartbeat_at")
        copied = dict(self.details)
        if not all(isinstance(key, str) and isinstance(value, str) for key, value in copied.items()):
            raise TypeError("details must map strings to strings")
        object.__setattr__(self, "details", MappingProxyType(copied))

    def effective_status(self, now: datetime, max_heartbeat_age: timedelta) -> HealthStatus:
        """Return OFFLINE for absent or stale heartbeat; otherwise the reported status."""
        _require_utc(now, "now")
        if max_heartbeat_age < timedelta(0):
            raise ValueError("max_heartbeat_age must be non-negative")
        if self.heartbeat_at is None or now - self.heartbeat_at > max_heartbeat_age:
            return HealthStatus.OFFLINE
        return self.status

"""Durable, restart-safe ENTRY eligibility controls.

Everything here gates *new entries only*.  The module deliberately exposes no
API that can block or delay fill ingestion, protective stop placement/updates,
reconciliation, manual close, or risk exits: every ``record_*`` method accepts
events unconditionally (and idempotently), and only
:meth:`EntryEligibilityEvaluator.evaluate` produces a block decision, which the
entry path alone consults.

Design choices:
1. State is persisted as plain JSON-compatible documents, one per account/scenario
   scope and component section, through :class:`EntryEligibilityRepository`
   (same load/save-or-await convention as the reservation ledger).  Decimals are
   stored as strings and instants as UTC ISO-8601 strings.
2. The trading day is the NY exchange session.  Instants on a non-trading day
   belong to the previous session, so counts reset only at the next session open
   day rather than at midnight or on a weekend.
3. A cycle closed with ``fee_status`` other than ``"final"`` still updates the
   streak from the computed net, but the result is recorded as provisional and
   the decision reports ``provisional=True`` when a lockout rests on it.
"""

+    ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"

+def _text(value: object, name: str, *, optional: bool = False) -> str | None:

+    account_id: str
+    scenario_id: str | None
+    symbol: str
+    mode: str
+    broker_order_id: str | None = None

+    limit_price: Decimal | None = None

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)

+    account_id: str

+    if explicit is not None:

+    body = json.dumps(dict(event), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), default=_json_default)

+def apply_event(
+    record: ProtectionStateRecord, event: Mapping[str, Any]

+        raise TypeError("record must be ProtectionStateRecord")
+    if not isinstance(event, Mapping):
+        raise TypeError("event must be a mapping")
+    kind = str(event.get("type", event.get("event_type", ""))).strip().lower().replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_")

+        "placement_requested": "placement_requested", "placement_request": "placement_requested",
+        "broker_ack": "broker_ack", "placement_confirmed": "broker_ack", "ack": "broker_ack",
+        "replace_requested": "replace_requested", "replace_confirmed": "replace_confirmed",
+        "cancel_confirmed": "cancel_confirmed", "trigger": "trigger", "fill": "trigger",
+        "trigger_fill": "trigger", "expiry": "expiry", "expired": "expiry",
+        "done_for_day": "expiry", "placement_failed": "failure", "coverage_failed": "failure",
+        "failure": "failure", "broker_unreadable": "unconfirmed", "unconfirmed": "unconfirmed",
+        "heartbeat_offline": "offline", "engine_offline": "offline", "offline": "offline",
+    }
+    if kind not in aliases:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported protection event {kind!r}")
+    kind = aliases[kind]
+    eid = _event_id(event)
+    if eid in record.applied_event_ids:
+        return record, ()
+    now = _utc(event.get("occurred_at", datetime.now(UTC)), "occurred_at")
+    assert now is not None
+    payload = dict(event)
+    target = record.condition
+    updates: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    reason = event.get("reason", record.reason)
+    terminal = {ProtectionCondition.TRIGGERED, ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED}

+        raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via {kind}")

+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via placement_requested")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.PENDING
+        updates["pending_since"] = now
+        reason = None
+    elif kind == "broker_ack":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.PENDING, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE, ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE}:

+        target = ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE
+        updates["last_broker_confirmed_at"] = now
+        updates["pending_since"] = None
+        reason = None
+    elif kind == "replace_requested":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via replace_requested")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.UPDATING
+    elif kind == "replace_confirmed":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via replace_confirmed")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE
+        updates["last_broker_confirmed_at"] = now
+        reason = None
+    elif kind == "cancel_confirmed":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE, ProtectionCondition.PENDING}:

+        reason = "UNPROTECTED_POSITION" if target is ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED else reason
+    elif kind == "trigger":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via trigger")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.TRIGGERED
+        filled = _decimal(event.get("filled_qty", record.protected_qty), "filled_qty")

+        updates["protected_qty"] = max(_ZERO, record.protected_qty - filled)
+        updates["last_broker_confirmed_at"] = now
+    elif kind == "expiry":

+            raise ValueError("expiry requires DAY TIF or done_for_day status")
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE, ProtectionCondition.PENDING}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via expiry")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED
+        reason = "PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT"
+    elif kind == "failure":
+        if record.condition in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE, ProtectionCondition.PENDING}:

+            reason = "UNPROTECTED_POSITION"
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via failure")
+    elif kind == "unconfirmed":
+        if record.condition in terminal:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via unconfirmed")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED
+        reason = str(event.get("reason", "BROKER_STATE_UNREADABLE"))
+    elif kind == "offline":
+        target = ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE
+        reason = str(event.get("reason", "ENGINE_OFFLINE"))

+    # Event fields may update the broker snapshot. A long-position stop may only rise.
+    for field in ("broker_order_id", "client_order_id", "protected_qty", "remaining_position_qty", "stop_price", "limit_price", "trail_price", "trail_percent", "broker_hwm", "tif"):

+            if field in {"protected_qty", "remaining_position_qty", "stop_price", "limit_price", "trail_price", "trail_percent", "broker_hwm"} and val is not None:

+class ProtectionStateStorage(Protocol):
+    """Atomic persistence port for append-only audit and current projection writes."""
+
+    def load(self, key: tuple[str, str, str | None, str]) -> ProtectionStateRecord | None: ...
+    def list_records(self, *, mode: str | None = None, account_id: str | None = None,

+    def commit(self, record: ProtectionStateRecord, events: tuple[_AuditEvent, ...]) -> None: ...

+class InMemoryProtectionStateStorage:
+    """Test storage with atomic append-only audit and upserted projection semantics."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._records: dict[tuple[str, str, str | None, str], ProtectionStateRecord] = {}
+        self._events: dict[str, _AuditEvent] = {}
+
+    @property
+    def audit_events(self) -> tuple[_AuditEvent, ...]:
+        return tuple(self._events.values())
+
+    def load(self, key: tuple[str, str, str | None, str]) -> ProtectionStateRecord | None:
+        return self._records.get(key)
+
+    def list_records(self, *, mode: str | None = None, account_id: str | None = None,
+                     scenario_id: str | None = None) -> tuple[ProtectionStateRecord, ...]:
+        return tuple(record for record in self._records.values()
+                     if (mode is None or record.mode == mode.upper())
+                     and (account_id is None or record.account_id == account_id)
+                     and (scenario_id is None or record.scenario_id == scenario_id))
+
+    def commit(self, record: ProtectionStateRecord, events: tuple[_AuditEvent, ...]) -> None:
+        for event in events:
+            self._events.setdefault(event.event_id, event)
+        self._records[record.key] = record
+
+
+class ProtectionStateRepository:
+    """Repository facade; supplied storage owns the app's single-writer transaction."""
+
+    def __init__(self, storage: ProtectionStateStorage) -> None:
+        if storage is None:
+            raise TypeError("storage is required")
+        self._storage = storage
+
+    def save_event(self, record: ProtectionStateRecord, event: Mapping[str, Any]) -> ProtectionStateRecord:
+        current = self._storage.load(record.key) or record
+        updated, events = apply_event(current, event)
+        if updated is not current:
+            self._storage.commit(updated, events)
+        return updated
+
+    def load(self, *, mode: str, account_id: str, scenario_id: str | None, cycle_id: str) -> ProtectionStateRecord | None:
+        return self._storage.load((mode.upper(), account_id, scenario_id, cycle_id))
+
+    def list_records(self, *, mode: str | None = None, account_id: str | None = None,
+                     scenario_id: str | None = None) -> tuple[ProtectionStateRecord, ...]:
+        return self._storage.list_records(mode=mode, account_id=account_id, scenario_id=scenario_id)
+

+def entry_block_reasons(
+    records: Any, *, now: datetime | None = None, pending_grace_period: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=30)
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Return fresh-entry protection blocks only; has no exit or reconciliation API."""
+    current = _utc(now if now is not None else datetime.now(UTC), "now")
+    assert current is not None
+    if pending_grace_period < timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError("pending_grace_period must be non-negative")
+    reasons: list[str] = []
+    for record in records:
+        if not isinstance(record, ProtectionStateRecord):
+            raise TypeError("records must contain ProtectionStateRecord values")
+        condition = record.condition
+        if condition is ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED:
+            reasons.append(record.reason or "UNPROTECTED_POSITION")
+        elif condition is ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED:
+            reasons.append("PROTECTION_UNCONFIRMED")
+        elif condition is ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED and record.remaining_position_qty > _ZERO:
+            reasons.append(record.reason or "PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT")
+        elif condition is ProtectionCondition.PENDING and record.pending_since is not None and current - record.pending_since > pending_grace_period:
+            reasons.append("PROTECTION_PENDING")
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(reasons))
+
+
+def to_dashboard_view(
+    record: ProtectionStateRecord, now: datetime, heartbeat_age: timedelta,
+    *, offline_after: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=60),
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read-only dashboard view; stale broker snapshot values remain visible."""
+    _utc(now, "now")
+    if heartbeat_age < timedelta(0) or offline_after < timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError("heartbeat ages must be non-negative")
+    offline = heartbeat_age > offline_after
+    return {
+        "cycle_id": record.cycle_id,
+        "account_id": record.account_id,
+        "scenario_id": record.scenario_id,
+        "symbol": record.symbol,
+        "mode": record.mode,
+        "condition": ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE if offline else record.condition,
+        "stale": offline,
+        "broker_order_id": record.broker_order_id,
+        "client_order_id": record.client_order_id,
+        "protected_qty": record.protected_qty,
+        "remaining_position_qty": record.remaining_position_qty,
+        "stop_price": record.stop_price,
+        "limit_price": record.limit_price,
+        "trail_price": record.trail_price,
+        "trail_percent": record.trail_percent,
+        "broker_hwm": record.broker_hwm,
+        "tif": record.tif,
+        "last_broker_confirmed_at": record.last_broker_confirmed_at,
+        "revision": record.revision,
+        "reason": record.reason if not offline else record.reason or "ENGINE_OFFLINE",
+    }

+    elif kind == "replace_requested":

+    elif kind == "cancel_confirmed":

+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via cancel_confirmed")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED if record.remaining_position_qty > _ZERO else ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED
+        reason = "UNPROTECTED_POSITION" if target is ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED else reason
+    elif kind == "trigger":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via trigger")

+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via expiry")

+        raise TypeError("record must be ProtectionStateRecord")
+    if not isinstance(event, Mapping):
+        raise TypeError("event must be a mapping")
+    kind = str(event.get("type", event.get("event_type", ""))).strip().lower().replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_")
+    done_for_day_event = kind == "done_for_day"
+    aliases = {
+        "placement_requested": "placement_requested", "placement_request": "placement_requested",
+        "broker_ack": "broker_ack", "placement_confirmed": "broker_ack", "ack": "broker_ack",
+        "replace_requested": "replace_requested", "replace_confirmed": "replace_confirmed",
+        "cancel_confirmed": "cancel_confirmed", "trigger": "trigger", "fill": "trigger",
+        "trigger_fill": "trigger", "expiry": "expiry", "expired": "expiry",
+        "done_for_day": "expiry", "placement_failed": "failure", "coverage_failed": "failure",
+        "failure": "failure", "broker_unreadable": "unconfirmed", "unconfirmed": "unconfirmed",
+        "heartbeat_offline": "offline", "engine_offline": "offline", "offline": "offline",
+    }
+    if kind not in aliases:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported protection event {kind!r}")
+    kind = aliases[kind]
+    eid = _event_id(record, event)
+    if eid in record.applied_event_ids:
+        return record, ()
+    now = _utc(event.get("occurred_at", datetime.now(UTC)), "occurred_at")
+    assert now is not None
+    payload = dict(event)
+    target = record.condition
+    updates: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    reason = event.get("reason", record.reason)
+    terminal = {ProtectionCondition.TRIGGERED, ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED}
+
+    if record.condition in terminal and kind not in {"offline"}:
+        raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via {kind}")
+    if kind == "placement_requested":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.PENDING, ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED, ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via placement_requested")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.PENDING
+        updates["pending_since"] = now
+        reason = None
+    elif kind == "broker_ack":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.PENDING, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE, ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via broker_ack")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE
+        updates["last_broker_confirmed_at"] = now
+        updates["pending_since"] = None
+        reason = None
+    elif kind == "replace_requested":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via replace_requested")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.UPDATING
+    elif kind == "replace_confirmed":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via replace_confirmed")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE
+        updates["last_broker_confirmed_at"] = now
+        reason = None
+    elif kind == "cancel_confirmed":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE, ProtectionCondition.PENDING}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via cancel_confirmed")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED if record.remaining_position_qty > _ZERO else ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED
+        reason = "UNPROTECTED_POSITION" if target is ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED else reason
+    elif kind == "trigger":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via trigger")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.TRIGGERED
+        filled = _decimal(event.get("filled_qty", record.protected_qty), "filled_qty")
+        updates["remaining_position_qty"] = max(_ZERO, record.remaining_position_qty - filled)
+        updates["protected_qty"] = max(_ZERO, record.protected_qty - filled)
+        updates["last_broker_confirmed_at"] = now
+    elif kind == "expiry":
+        if record.tif != "DAY" and str(event.get("status", "")).lower() != "done_for_day" and not done_for_day_event:
+            raise ValueError("expiry requires DAY TIF or done_for_day status")
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE, ProtectionCondition.PENDING}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via expiry")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED
+        reason = "PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT"
+    elif kind == "failure":
+        if record.condition in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE, ProtectionCondition.PENDING}:
+            target = ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED
+            reason = "UNPROTECTED_POSITION"
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via failure")
+    elif kind == "unconfirmed":
+        if record.condition in terminal:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via unconfirmed")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED
+        reason = str(event.get("reason", "BROKER_STATE_UNREADABLE"))
+    elif kind == "offline":
+        target = ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE
+        reason = str(event.get("reason", "ENGINE_OFFLINE"))
+
+    # Event fields may update the broker snapshot. A long-position stop may only rise.
+    for field in ("broker_order_id", "client_order_id", "protected_qty", "remaining_position_qty", "stop_price", "limit_price", "trail_price", "trail_percent", "broker_hwm", "tif"):
+        if field in event:
+            val = event[field]
+            if field in {"protected_qty", "remaining_position_qty", "stop_price", "limit_price", "trail_price", "trail_percent", "broker_hwm"} and val is not None:
+                val = _decimal(val, field)
+            if field in {"broker_order_id", "client_order_id"} and val is not None:
+                val = _text(val, field)
+            if field == "tif" and val is not None:
+                val = str(val).strip().upper()
+            updates[field] = val
+    proposed_stop = updates.get("stop_price", record.stop_price)
+    if record.stop_price is not None and proposed_stop is not None and proposed_stop < record.stop_price:
+        raise ValueError("stop_price may not decrease for a long position")
+    if reason is not None:
+        reason = _text(str(reason), "reason")
+    updates.update(condition=target, reason=reason, revision=record.revision + 1,
+                   applied_event_ids=record.applied_event_ids | {eid})
+    updated = replace(record, **updates)
+    audit = _AuditEvent(eid, record.cycle_id, record.account_id, record.scenario_id,
+                        record.mode, record.execution_mode, kind.upper(), now, updated.reason, payload)
+    return updated, (audit,)
+
+
+class ProtectionStateStorage(Protocol):
+    """Atomic persistence port for append-only audit and current projection writes."""
+
+    def load(self, key: tuple[str, str, str | None, str]) -> ProtectionStateRecord | None: ...
+    def list_records(self, *, mode: str | None = None, account_id: str | None = None,
+                     scenario_id: str | None = None) -> tuple[ProtectionStateRecord, ...]: ...
+    def commit(self, record: ProtectionStateRecord, events: tuple[_AuditEvent, ...]) -> None: ...
+
+
+class InMemoryProtectionStateStorage:
+    """Test storage with atomic append-only audit and upserted projection semantics."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._records: dict[tuple[str, str, str | None, str], ProtectionStateRecord] = {}
+        self._events: dict[str, _AuditEvent] = {}
+
+    @property
+    def audit_events(self) -> tuple[_AuditEvent, ...]:
+        return tuple(self._events.values())
+
+    def load(self, key: tuple[str, str, str | None, str]) -> ProtectionStateRecord | None:
+        return self._records.get(key)
+
+    def list_records(self, *, mode: str | None = None, account_id: str | None = None,
+                     scenario_id: str | None = None) -> tuple[ProtectionStateRecord, ...]:
+        return tuple(record for record in self._records.values()
+                     if (mode is None or record.execution_mode == mode.upper())
+                     and (account_id is None or record.account_id == account_id)
+                     and (scenario_id is None or record.scenario_id == scenario_id))
+
+    def commit(self, record: ProtectionStateRecord, events: tuple[_AuditEvent, ...]) -> None:
+        for event in events:
+            self._events.setdefault(event.event_id, event)
+        self._records[record.key] = record
+
+
+class ProtectionStateRepository:
+    """Repository facade; supplied storage owns the app's single-writer transaction."""
+
+    def __init__(self, storage: ProtectionStateStorage) -> None:
+        if storage is None:
+            raise TypeError("storage is required")
+        self._storage = storage
+
+    def save_event(self, record: ProtectionStateRecord, event: Mapping[str, Any]) -> ProtectionStateRecord:
+        current = self._storage.load(record.key) or record
+        updated, events = apply_event(current, event)
+        if updated is not current:
+            self._storage.commit(updated, events)
+        return updated
+
+    def load(self, *, mode: str, account_id: str, scenario_id: str | None, cycle_id: str) -> ProtectionStateRecord | None:
+        return self._storage.load((mode.upper(), account_id, scenario_id, cycle_id))
+
+    def list_records(self, *, mode: str | None = None, account_id: str | None = None,
+                     scenario_id: str | None = None) -> tuple[ProtectionStateRecord, ...]:
+        return self._storage.list_records(mode=mode, account_id=account_id, scenario_id=scenario_id)
+
+
+def entry_block_reasons(
+    records: Any, *, now: datetime | None = None, pending_grace_period: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=30)
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Return fresh-entry protection blocks only; has no exit or reconciliation API."""
+    current = _utc(now if now is not None else datetime.now(UTC), "now")
+    assert current is not None
+    if pending_grace_period < timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError("pending_grace_period must be non-negative")
+    reasons: list[str] = []
+    for record in records:
+        if not isinstance(record, ProtectionStateRecord):
+            raise TypeError("records must contain ProtectionStateRecord values")
+        condition = record.condition
+        if condition is ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED:
+            reasons.append(record.reason or "UNPROTECTED_POSITION")
+        elif condition is ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED:
+            reasons.append("PROTECTION_UNCONFIRMED")
+        elif condition is ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED and record.remaining_position_qty > _ZERO:
+            reasons.append(record.reason or "PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT")
+        elif condition is ProtectionCondition.PENDING and record.pending_since is not None and current - record.pending_since > pending_grace_period:
+            reasons.append("PROTECTION_PENDING")
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(reasons))
+
+
+def to_dashboard_view(
+    record: ProtectionStateRecord, now: datetime, heartbeat_age: timedelta,
+    *, offline_after: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=60),
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read-only dashboard view; stale broker snapshot values remain visible."""
+    _utc(now, "now")
+    if heartbeat_age < timedelta(0) or offline_after < timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError("heartbeat ages must be non-negative")
+    offline = heartbeat_age > offline_after
+    return {
+        "cycle_id": record.cycle_id,
+        "account_id": record.account_id,
+        "scenario_id": record.scenario_id,
+        "symbol": record.symbol,
+        "mode": record.mode,
+        "execution_mode": record.execution_mode,
+        "condition": ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE if offline else record.condition,
+        "stale": offline,
+        "broker_order_id": record.broker_order_id,
+        "client_order_id": record.client_order_id,
+        "protected_qty": record.protected_qty,
+        "remaining_position_qty": record.remaining_position_qty,
+        "stop_price": record.stop_price,
+        "limit_price": record.limit_price,
+        "trail_price": record.trail_price,
+        "trail_percent": record.trail_percent,
+        "broker_hwm": record.broker_hwm,
+        "tif": record.tif,
+        "last_broker_confirmed_at": record.last_broker_confirmed_at,
+        "revision": record.revision,
+        "reason": record.reason if not offline else record.reason or "ENGINE_OFFLINE",
+    }

@@ -0,0 +1,129 @@
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.risk.stop_state import (
+    InMemoryProtectionStateStorage,
+    ProtectionCondition,
+    ProtectionStateRecord,
+    ProtectionStateRepository,
+    apply_event,
+    entry_block_reasons,
+    to_dashboard_view,
+)
+
+
+NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 8, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+
+
+def record(**changes):
+    values = dict(
+        cycle_id="cycle-1",
+        account_id="account-1",
+        scenario_id=None,
+        symbol="AAPL",
+        mode="FIXED",
+        execution_mode="PAPER",
+        protected_qty=Decimal("10"),
+        remaining_position_qty=Decimal("10"),
+        stop_price=Decimal("95"),
+        condition=ProtectionCondition.PENDING,
+    )
+    values.update(changes)
+    return ProtectionStateRecord(**values)
+
+
+def event(kind, **values):
+    return {"type": kind, "occurred_at": NOW, **values}
+
+
+def test_all_conditions_reachable_through_legal_events():
+    pending = record()
+    pending, _ = apply_event(pending, event("placement_requested", event_id="place"))
+    assert pending.condition is ProtectionCondition.PENDING
+    active, _ = apply_event(pending, event("broker_ack", broker_order_id="b1", broker_update_id="ack"))
+    assert active.condition is ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE
+    updating, _ = apply_event(active, event("replace_requested", stop_price=Decimal("96")))
+    assert updating.condition is ProtectionCondition.UPDATING
+    unconfirmed, _ = apply_event(updating, event("broker_unreadable"))
+    assert unconfirmed.condition is ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED
+    active_again, _ = apply_event(unconfirmed, event("replace_confirmed"))
+    assert active_again.condition is ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE
+    triggered, _ = apply_event(active_again, event("trigger", filled_qty=Decimal("10")))
+    assert triggered.condition is ProtectionCondition.TRIGGERED
+
+    expired, audit = apply_event(record(tif="DAY"), event("expiry"))
+    assert expired.condition is ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED
+    assert expired.reason == "PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT"
+    assert audit[0].reason == "PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT"
+    failed, _ = apply_event(record(), event("placement_failed"))
+    assert failed.condition is ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED
+    offline, _ = apply_event(record(), event("engine_offline"))
+    assert offline.condition is ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE
+
+
+def test_illegal_terminal_reactivation_and_long_stop_decrease_rejected():
+    triggered, _ = apply_event(record(), event("trigger"))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="illegal transition"):
+        apply_event(triggered, event("broker_ack"))
+    active, _ = apply_event(record(), event("broker_ack"))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="may not decrease"):
+        apply_event(active, event("replace_requested", stop_price=Decimal("94")))
+
+
+def test_done_for_day_expiry_and_unprotected_entry_blocks():
+    expired, _ = apply_event(record(), event("done_for_day"))
+    assert expired.condition is ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED
+    assert expired.reason == "PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT"
+    unprotected, _ = apply_event(record(), event("coverage_failed"))
+    assert unprotected.reason == "UNPROTECTED_POSITION"
+    assert entry_block_reasons([unprotected]) == ["UNPROTECTED_POSITION"]
+    assert entry_block_reasons([expired]) == ["PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT"]
+
+
+def test_pending_blocks_only_after_grace_period_and_unconfirmed_blocks():
+    pending, _ = apply_event(record(), event("placement_requested"))
+    later = NOW + timedelta(seconds=31)
+    assert entry_block_reasons([pending], now=later, pending_grace_period=timedelta(seconds=30)) == ["PROTECTION_PENDING"]
+    assert entry_block_reasons([pending], now=NOW + timedelta(seconds=10), pending_grace_period=timedelta(seconds=30)) == []
+    unconfirmed, _ = apply_event(record(), event("broker_unreadable"))
+    assert entry_block_reasons([unconfirmed]) == ["PROTECTION_UNCONFIRMED"]
+
+
+def test_duplicate_broker_update_is_idempotent_and_audit_is_append_only():
+    storage = InMemoryProtectionStateStorage()
+    repo = ProtectionStateRepository(storage)
+    initial = record()
+    update = event("broker_ack", broker_order_id="broker-1", broker_update_id="update-1")
+    first = repo.save_event(initial, update)
+    audit_count = len(storage.audit_events)
+    second = repo.save_event(initial, update)
+    assert second is first
+    assert second.revision == first.revision
+    assert len(storage.audit_events) == audit_count == 1
+
+
+def test_paper_and_shadow_records_with_same_cycle_are_isolated():
+    storage = InMemoryProtectionStateStorage()
+    repo = ProtectionStateRepository(storage)
+    paper = record(execution_mode="PAPER")
+    shadow = record(execution_mode="SHADOW", scenario_id="scenario-1")
+    paper_active = repo.save_event(paper, event("broker_ack", broker_order_id="paper-order", broker_update_id="same"))
+    shadow_failed = repo.save_event(shadow, event("coverage_failed", broker_update_id="same"))
+    assert repo.load(mode="PAPER", account_id="account-1", scenario_id=None, cycle_id="cycle-1") == paper_active
+    assert repo.load(mode="SHADOW", account_id="account-1", scenario_id="scenario-1", cycle_id="cycle-1") == shadow_failed
+    assert paper_active.condition is ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE
+    assert shadow_failed.condition is ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED
+    assert len(repo.list_records(mode="PAPER")) == 1
+    assert len(repo.list_records(mode="SHADOW")) == 1
+
+
+def test_dashboard_projection_marks_values_stale_and_offline():
+    active, _ = apply_event(record(), event("broker_ack", broker_order_id="b-1"))
+    view = to_dashboard_view(active, NOW, timedelta(seconds=61), offline_after=timedelta(seconds=60))
+    assert view["condition"] is ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE
+    assert view["stale"] is True
+    assert view["broker_order_id"] == "b-1"
+    assert view["stop_price"] == Decimal("95")
+

@@ -0,0 +1,400 @@
+"""Persisted broker-stop lifecycle and read projections.
+
+TODO: Add a protection-state projection and append-only audit table migration.
+Migration files are outside this task's allowed write paths, so persistence is
+defined against an injected atomic storage protocol until that migration lands.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Any, Mapping, Protocol
+
+__all__ = [
+    "ProtectionCondition",
+    "ProtectionStateRecord",
+    "apply_event",
+    "ProtectionStateRepository",
+    "entry_block_reasons",
+    "to_dashboard_view",
+]
+
+
+class ProtectionCondition(StrEnum):
+    PENDING = "PENDING"
+    ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"
+    UPDATING = "UPDATING"
+    UNCONFIRMED = "UNCONFIRMED"
+    TRIGGERED = "TRIGGERED"
+    EXPIRED = "EXPIRED"
+    UNPROTECTED = "UNPROTECTED"
+    OFFLINE = "OFFLINE"
+
+
+_MODES = frozenset({"FIXED", "TRAILING_NATIVE", "TRAILING_STEPPED"})
+_EXECUTION_MODES = frozenset({"BACKTEST", "SHADOW", "PAPER", "LIVE"})
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+
+
+def _text(value: object, name: str, *, optional: bool = False) -> str | None:
+    if value is None and optional:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime | None, name: str, *, optional: bool = False) -> datetime | None:
+    if value is None and optional:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware UTC datetime")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, name: str, *, optional: bool = False) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None and optional:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal) or not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite Decimal")
+    return value
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ProtectionStateRecord:
+    cycle_id: str
+    account_id: str
+    scenario_id: str | None
+    symbol: str
+    mode: str
+    execution_mode: str = "PAPER"
+    broker_order_id: str | None = None
+    client_order_id: str | None = None
+    protected_qty: Decimal = _ZERO
+    remaining_position_qty: Decimal = _ZERO
+    stop_price: Decimal | None = None
+    limit_price: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_price: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None
+    broker_hwm: Decimal | None = None
+    tif: str = "GTC"
+    condition: ProtectionCondition = ProtectionCondition.PENDING
+    last_broker_confirmed_at: datetime | None = None
+    revision: int = 0
+    reason: str | None = None
+    pending_since: datetime | None = None
+    applied_event_ids: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for name in ("cycle_id", "account_id", "symbol"):
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, _text(getattr(self, name), name))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", self.symbol.upper())
+        if self.scenario_id is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "scenario_id", _text(self.scenario_id, "scenario_id"))
+        mode = _text(self.mode, "mode").upper()
+        if mode not in _MODES:
+            raise ValueError(f"mode must be one of {sorted(_MODES)}")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "mode", mode)
+        execution_mode = _text(self.execution_mode, "execution_mode").upper()
+        if execution_mode not in _EXECUTION_MODES:
+            raise ValueError(f"execution_mode must be one of {sorted(_EXECUTION_MODES)}")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "execution_mode", execution_mode)
+        for name in ("broker_order_id", "client_order_id", "reason"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value is not None:
+                object.__setattr__(self, name, _text(value, name))
+        for name in ("protected_qty", "remaining_position_qty"):
+            value = _decimal(getattr(self, name), name)
+            if value < _ZERO:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-negative")
+        for name in ("stop_price", "limit_price", "trail_price", "trail_percent", "broker_hwm"):
+            _decimal(getattr(self, name), name, optional=True)
+        if self.mode != "TRAILING_NATIVE" and self.broker_hwm is not None:
+            raise ValueError("broker_hwm is only valid for TRAILING_NATIVE protection")
+        if not isinstance(self.tif, str) or not self.tif.strip():
+            raise ValueError("tif must be a non-empty string")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "tif", self.tif.strip().upper())
+        if not isinstance(self.condition, ProtectionCondition):
+            object.__setattr__(self, "condition", ProtectionCondition(self.condition))
+        if isinstance(self.revision, bool) or not isinstance(self.revision, int) or self.revision < 0:
+            raise ValueError("revision must be a non-negative integer")

+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.risk.stop_state import (
+    InMemoryProtectionStateStorage,
+    ProtectionCondition,
+    ProtectionStateRecord,
+    ProtectionStateRepository,
+    apply_event,
+    entry_block_reasons,
+    to_dashboard_view,
+)
+
+
+NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 8, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+
+
+def record(**changes):
+    values = dict(
+        cycle_id="cycle-1",
+        account_id="account-1",
+        scenario_id=None,
+        symbol="AAPL",
+        mode="FIXED",
+        execution_mode="PAPER",
+        protected_qty=Decimal("10"),
+        remaining_position_qty=Decimal("10"),
+        stop_price=Decimal("95"),
+        condition=ProtectionCondition.PENDING,
+    )
+    values.update(changes)
+    return ProtectionStateRecord(**values)
+
+
+def event(kind, **values):
+    return {"type": kind, "occurred_at": NOW, **values}
+
+
+def test_all_conditions_reachable_through_legal_events():
+    pending = record()
+    pending, _ = apply_event(pending, event("placement_requested", event_id="place"))
+    assert pending.condition is ProtectionCondition.PENDING
+    active, _ = apply_event(pending, event("broker_ack", broker_order_id="b1", broker_update_id="ack"))
+    assert active.condition is ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE
+    updating, _ = apply_event(active, event("replace_requested", stop_price=Decimal("96")))
+    assert updating.condition is ProtectionCondition.UPDATING
+    unconfirmed, _ = apply_event(updating, event("broker_unreadable"))
+    assert unconfirmed.condition is ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED
+    active_again, _ = apply_event(unconfirmed, event("replace_confirmed"))
+    assert active_again.condition is ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE
+    triggered, _ = apply_event(active_again, event("trigger", filled_qty=Decimal("10")))
+    assert triggered.condition is ProtectionCondition.TRIGGERED
+
+    expired, audit = apply_event(record(tif="DAY"), event("expiry"))
+    assert expired.condition is ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED
+    assert expired.reason == "PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT"
+    assert audit[0].reason == "PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT"
+    failed, _ = apply_event(record(), event("placement_failed"))
+    assert failed.condition is ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED
+    offline, _ = apply_event(record(), event("engine_offline"))
+    assert offline.condition is ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE
+
+
+def test_illegal_terminal_reactivation_and_long_stop_decrease_rejected():
+    triggered, _ = apply_event(record(), event("trigger"))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="illegal transition"):
+        apply_event(triggered, event("broker_ack"))
+    active, _ = apply_event(record(), event("broker_ack"))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="may not decrease"):
+        apply_event(active, event("replace_requested", stop_price=Decimal("94")))
+
+
+def test_done_for_day_expiry_and_unprotected_entry_blocks():
+    expired, _ = apply_event(record(), event("done_for_day"))
+    assert expired.condition is ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED
+    assert expired.reason == "PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT"
+    unprotected, _ = apply_event(record(), event("coverage_failed"))
+    assert unprotected.reason == "UNPROTECTED_POSITION"
+    assert entry_block_reasons([unprotected]) == ["UNPROTECTED_POSITION"]
+    assert entry_block_reasons([expired]) == ["PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT"]
+
+
+def test_pending_blocks_only_after_grace_period_and_unconfirmed_blocks():
+    pending, _ = apply_event(record(), event("placement_requested"))
+    later = NOW + timedelta(seconds=31)
+    assert entry_block_reasons([pending], now=later, pending_grace_period=timedelta(seconds=30)) == ["PROTECTION_PENDING"]
+    assert entry_block_reasons([pending], now=NOW + timedelta(seconds=10), pending_grace_period=timedelta(seconds=30)) == []
+    unconfirmed, _ = apply_event(record(), event("broker_unreadable"))
+    assert entry_block_reasons([unconfirmed]) == ["PROTECTION_UNCONFIRMED"]
+
+
+def test_duplicate_broker_update_is_idempotent_and_audit_is_append_only():
+    storage = InMemoryProtectionStateStorage()
+    repo = ProtectionStateRepository(storage)
+    initial = record()
+    update = event("broker_ack", broker_order_id="broker-1", broker_update_id="update-1")
+    first = repo.save_event(initial, update)
+    audit_count = len(storage.audit_events)
+    second = repo.save_event(initial, update)
+    assert second is first
+    assert second.revision == first.revision
+    assert len(storage.audit_events) == audit_count == 1
+
+
+def test_paper_and_shadow_records_with_same_cycle_are_isolated():
+    storage = InMemoryProtectionStateStorage()
+    repo = ProtectionStateRepository(storage)
+    paper = record(execution_mode="PAPER")
+    shadow = record(execution_mode="SHADOW", scenario_id="scenario-1")
+    paper_active = repo.save_event(paper, event("broker_ack", broker_order_id="paper-order", broker_update_id="same"))
+    shadow_failed = repo.save_event(shadow, event("coverage_failed", broker_update_id="same"))
+    assert repo.load(mode="PAPER", account_id="account-1", scenario_id=None, cycle_id="cycle-1") == paper_active
+    assert repo.load(mode="SHADOW", account_id="account-1", scenario_id="scenario-1", cycle_id="cycle-1") == shadow_failed
+    assert paper_active.condition is ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE
+    assert shadow_failed.condition is ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED
+    assert len(repo.list_records(mode="PAPER")) == 1
+    assert len(repo.list_records(mode="SHADOW")) == 1
+
+
+def test_dashboard_projection_marks_values_stale_and_offline():
+    active, _ = apply_event(record(), event("broker_ack", broker_order_id="b-1"))
+    view = to_dashboard_view(active, NOW, timedelta(seconds=61), offline_after=timedelta(seconds=60))
+    assert view["condition"] is ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE
+    assert view["stale"] is True
+    assert view["broker_order_id"] == "b-1"
+    assert view["stop_price"] == Decimal("95")
+

+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware UTC datetime")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, name: str, *, optional: bool = False) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None and optional:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal) or not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite Decimal")
+    return value
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ProtectionStateRecord:
+    cycle_id: str
+    account_id: str
+    scenario_id: str | None
+    symbol: str
+    mode: str
+    execution_mode: str = "PAPER"
+    broker_order_id: str | None = None
+    client_order_id: str | None = None
+    protected_qty: Decimal = _ZERO
+    remaining_position_qty: Decimal = _ZERO
+    stop_price: Decimal | None = None
+    limit_price: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_price: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None
+    broker_hwm: Decimal | None = None
+    tif: str = "GTC"
+    condition: ProtectionCondition = ProtectionCondition.PENDING
+    last_broker_confirmed_at: datetime | None = None
+    revision: int = 0
+    reason: str | None = None
+    pending_since: datetime | None = None
+    applied_event_ids: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for name in ("cycle_id", "account_id", "symbol"):
+            object.__setattr__(self, name, _text(getattr(self, name), name))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", self.symbol.upper())
+        if self.scenario_id is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "scenario_id", _text(self.scenario_id, "scenario_id"))
+        mode = _text(self.mode, "mode").upper()
+        if mode not in _MODES:
+            raise ValueError(f"mode must be one of {sorted(_MODES)}")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "mode", mode)
+        execution_mode = _text(self.execution_mode, "execution_mode").upper()
+        if execution_mode not in _EXECUTION_MODES:
+            raise ValueError(f"execution_mode must be one of {sorted(_EXECUTION_MODES)}")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "execution_mode", execution_mode)
+        for name in ("broker_order_id", "client_order_id", "reason"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value is not None:
+                object.__setattr__(self, name, _text(value, name))
+        for name in ("protected_qty", "remaining_position_qty"):
+            value = _decimal(getattr(self, name), name)
+            if value < _ZERO:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-negative")
+        for name in ("stop_price", "limit_price", "trail_price", "trail_percent", "broker_hwm"):
+            _decimal(getattr(self, name), name, optional=True)
+        if self.mode != "TRAILING_NATIVE" and self.broker_hwm is not None:
+            raise ValueError("broker_hwm is only valid for TRAILING_NATIVE protection")
+        if not isinstance(self.tif, str) or not self.tif.strip():
+            raise ValueError("tif must be a non-empty string")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "tif", self.tif.strip().upper())
+        if not isinstance(self.condition, ProtectionCondition):
+            object.__setattr__(self, "condition", ProtectionCondition(self.condition))
+        if isinstance(self.revision, bool) or not isinstance(self.revision, int) or self.revision < 0:
+            raise ValueError("revision must be a non-negative integer")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "last_broker_confirmed_at", _utc(self.last_broker_confirmed_at, "last_broker_confirmed_at", optional=True))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "pending_since", _utc(self.pending_since, "pending_since", optional=True))
+        if not isinstance(self.applied_event_ids, frozenset):
+            raise TypeError("applied_event_ids must be a frozenset")
+
+    @property
+    def key(self) -> tuple[str, str, str | None, str]:
+        """Mode/account/scenario/cycle key; cycle ids are scoped, not global."""
+        return (self.execution_mode, self.account_id, self.scenario_id, self.cycle_id)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class _AuditEvent:
+    event_id: str
+    cycle_id: str
+    account_id: str
+    scenario_id: str | None
+    mode: str
+    execution_mode: str
+    event_type: str
+    occurred_at: datetime
+    reason: str | None
+    payload: Mapping[str, Any]
+
+
+def _json_default(value: object) -> str:
+    if isinstance(value, (Decimal, datetime, StrEnum)):
+        return value.isoformat() if isinstance(value, datetime) else str(value)
+    raise TypeError(f"unsupported event value: {type(value).__name__}")
+
+
+def _event_id(record: ProtectionStateRecord, event: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    explicit = event.get("broker_update_id") or event.get("event_id")
+    if explicit is not None:
+        value = f"{record.execution_mode}|{record.account_id}|{record.scenario_id}|{record.cycle_id}|{explicit}"
+        return hashlib.sha256(value.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+    body = json.dumps(dict(event), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), default=_json_default)
+    return hashlib.sha256(body.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+def apply_event(
+    record: ProtectionStateRecord, event: Mapping[str, Any]
+) -> tuple[ProtectionStateRecord, tuple[_AuditEvent, ...]]:
+    """Apply one lifecycle event without I/O; illegal lifecycle changes raise ValueError."""
+    if not isinstance(record, ProtectionStateRecord):
+        raise TypeError("record must be ProtectionStateRecord")
+    if not isinstance(event, Mapping):
+        raise TypeError("event must be a mapping")
+    kind = str(event.get("type", event.get("event_type", ""))).strip().lower().replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_")
+    done_for_day_event = kind == "done_for_day"
+    aliases = {
+        "placement_requested": "placement_requested", "placement_request": "placement_requested",
+        "broker_ack": "broker_ack", "placement_confirmed": "broker_ack", "ack": "broker_ack",
+        "replace_requested": "replace_requested", "replace_confirmed": "replace_confirmed",
+        "cancel_confirmed": "cancel_confirmed", "trigger": "trigger", "fill": "trigger",
+        "trigger_fill": "trigger", "expiry": "expiry", "expired": "expiry",
+        "done_for_day": "expiry", "placement_failed": "failure", "coverage_failed": "failure",
+        "failure": "failure", "broker_unreadable": "unconfirmed", "unconfirmed": "unconfirmed",
+        "heartbeat_offline": "offline", "engine_offline": "offline", "offline": "offline",
+    }
+    if kind not in aliases:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported protection event {kind!r}")
+    kind = aliases[kind]
+    eid = _event_id(record, event)
+    if eid in record.applied_event_ids:
+        return record, ()
+    now = _utc(event.get("occurred_at", datetime.now(UTC)), "occurred_at")
+    assert now is not None
+    payload = dict(event)
+    target = record.condition
+    updates: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    reason = event.get("reason", record.reason)
+    terminal = {ProtectionCondition.TRIGGERED, ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED}
+
+    if record.condition in terminal and kind not in {"offline"}:
+        raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via {kind}")
+    if kind == "placement_requested":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.PENDING, ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED, ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via placement_requested")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.PENDING
+        updates["pending_since"] = now
+        reason = None
+    elif kind == "broker_ack":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.PENDING, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE, ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via broker_ack")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE
+        updates["last_broker_confirmed_at"] = now
+        updates["pending_since"] = None
+        reason = None
+    elif kind == "replace_requested":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via replace_requested")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.UPDATING
+    elif kind == "replace_confirmed":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via replace_confirmed")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE
+        updates["last_broker_confirmed_at"] = now
+        reason = None
+    elif kind == "cancel_confirmed":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE, ProtectionCondition.PENDING}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via cancel_confirmed")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED if record.remaining_position_qty > _ZERO else ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED
+        reason = "UNPROTECTED_POSITION" if target is ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED else reason
+    elif kind == "trigger":
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via trigger")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.TRIGGERED
+        filled = _decimal(event.get("filled_qty", record.protected_qty), "filled_qty")
+        updates["remaining_position_qty"] = max(_ZERO, record.remaining_position_qty - filled)
+        updates["protected_qty"] = max(_ZERO, record.protected_qty - filled)
+        updates["last_broker_confirmed_at"] = now
+    elif kind == "expiry":
+        if record.tif != "DAY" and str(event.get("status", "")).lower() != "done_for_day" and not done_for_day_event:
+            raise ValueError("expiry requires DAY TIF or done_for_day status")
+        if record.condition not in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE, ProtectionCondition.PENDING}:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via expiry")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED
+        reason = "PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT"
+    elif kind == "failure":
+        if record.condition in {ProtectionCondition.ACTIVE, ProtectionCondition.UPDATING, ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED, ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE, ProtectionCondition.PENDING}:
+            target = ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED
+            reason = "UNPROTECTED_POSITION"
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via failure")
+    elif kind == "unconfirmed":
+        if record.condition in terminal:
+            raise ValueError(f"illegal transition from {record.condition.value} via unconfirmed")
+        target = ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED
+        reason = str(event.get("reason", "BROKER_STATE_UNREADABLE"))
+    elif kind == "offline":
+        target = ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE
+        reason = str(event.get("reason", "ENGINE_OFFLINE"))
+
+    # Event fields may update the broker snapshot. A long-position stop may only rise.
+    for field in ("broker_order_id", "client_order_id", "protected_qty", "remaining_position_qty", "stop_price", "limit_price", "trail_price", "trail_percent", "broker_hwm", "tif"):
+        if field in event:
+            val = event[field]
+            if field in {"protected_qty", "remaining_position_qty", "stop_price", "limit_price", "trail_price", "trail_percent", "broker_hwm"} and val is not None:
+                val = _decimal(val, field)
+            if field in {"broker_order_id", "client_order_id"} and val is not None:
+                val = _text(val, field)
+            if field == "tif" and val is not None:
+                val = str(val).strip().upper()
+            updates[field] = val
+    proposed_stop = updates.get("stop_price", record.stop_price)
+    if record.stop_price is not None and proposed_stop is not None and proposed_stop < record.stop_price:
+        raise ValueError("stop_price may not decrease for a long position")
+    if reason is not None:
+        reason = _text(str(reason), "reason")
+    updates.update(condition=target, reason=reason, revision=record.revision + 1,
+                   applied_event_ids=record.applied_event_ids | {eid})
+    updated = replace(record, **updates)
+    audit = _AuditEvent(eid, record.cycle_id, record.account_id, record.scenario_id,
+                        record.mode, record.execution_mode, kind.upper(), now, updated.reason, payload)
+    return updated, (audit,)
+
+
+class ProtectionStateStorage(Protocol):
+    """Atomic persistence port for append-only audit and current projection writes."""
+
+    def load(self, key: tuple[str, str, str | None, str]) -> ProtectionStateRecord | None: ...
+    def list_records(self, *, mode: str | None = None, account_id: str | None = None,
+                     scenario_id: str | None = None) -> tuple[ProtectionStateRecord, ...]: ...
+    def commit(self, record: ProtectionStateRecord, events: tuple[_AuditEvent, ...]) -> None: ...
+
+
+class InMemoryProtectionStateStorage:
+    """Test storage with atomic append-only audit and upserted projection semantics."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._records: dict[tuple[str, str, str | None, str], ProtectionStateRecord] = {}
+        self._events: dict[str, _AuditEvent] = {}
+
+    @property
+    def audit_events(self) -> tuple[_AuditEvent, ...]:
+        return tuple(self._events.values())
+
+    def load(self, key: tuple[str, str, str | None, str]) -> ProtectionStateRecord | None:
+        return self._records.get(key)
+
+    def list_records(self, *, mode: str | None = None, account_id: str | None = None,
+                     scenario_id: str | None = None) -> tuple[ProtectionStateRecord, ...]:
+        return tuple(record for record in self._records.values()
+                     if (mode is None or record.execution_mode == mode.upper())
+                     and (account_id is None or record.account_id == account_id)
+                     and (scenario_id is None or record.scenario_id == scenario_id))
+
+    def commit(self, record: ProtectionStateRecord, events: tuple[_AuditEvent, ...]) -> None:
+        for event in events:
+            self._events.setdefault(event.event_id, event)
+        self._records[record.key] = record
+
+
+class ProtectionStateRepository:
+    """Repository facade; supplied storage owns the app's single-writer transaction."""
+
+    def __init__(self, storage: ProtectionStateStorage) -> None:
+        if storage is None:
+            raise TypeError("storage is required")
+        self._storage = storage
+
+    def save_event(self, record: ProtectionStateRecord, event: Mapping[str, Any]) -> ProtectionStateRecord:
+        current = self._storage.load(record.key) or record
+        updated, events = apply_event(current, event)
+        if updated is not current:
+            self._storage.commit(updated, events)
+        return updated
+
+    def load(self, *, mode: str, account_id: str, scenario_id: str | None, cycle_id: str) -> ProtectionStateRecord | None:
+        return self._storage.load((mode.upper(), account_id, scenario_id, cycle_id))
+
+    def list_records(self, *, mode: str | None = None, account_id: str | None = None,
+                     scenario_id: str | None = None) -> tuple[ProtectionStateRecord, ...]:
+        return self._storage.list_records(mode=mode, account_id=account_id, scenario_id=scenario_id)
+
+
+def entry_block_reasons(
+    records: Any, *, now: datetime | None = None, pending_grace_period: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=30)
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Return fresh-entry protection blocks only; has no exit or reconciliation API."""
+    current = _utc(now if now is not None else datetime.now(UTC), "now")
+    assert current is not None
+    if pending_grace_period < timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError("pending_grace_period must be non-negative")
+    reasons: list[str] = []
+    for record in records:
+        if not isinstance(record, ProtectionStateRecord):
+            raise TypeError("records must contain ProtectionStateRecord values")
+        condition = record.condition
+        if condition is ProtectionCondition.UNPROTECTED:
+            reasons.append(record.reason or "UNPROTECTED_POSITION")
+        elif condition is ProtectionCondition.UNCONFIRMED:
+            reasons.append("PROTECTION_UNCONFIRMED")
+        elif condition is ProtectionCondition.EXPIRED and record.remaining_position_qty > _ZERO:
+            reasons.append(record.reason or "PROTECTION_EXPIRED/OVERNIGHT")
+        elif condition is ProtectionCondition.PENDING and record.pending_since is not None and current - record.pending_since > pending_grace_period:
+            reasons.append("PROTECTION_PENDING")
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(reasons))
+
+
+def to_dashboard_view(
+    record: ProtectionStateRecord, now: datetime, heartbeat_age: timedelta,
+    *, offline_after: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=60),
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read-only dashboard view; stale broker snapshot values remain visible."""
+    _utc(now, "now")
+    if heartbeat_age < timedelta(0) or offline_after < timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError("heartbeat ages must be non-negative")
+    offline = heartbeat_age > offline_after
+    return {
+        "cycle_id": record.cycle_id,
+        "account_id": record.account_id,
+        "scenario_id": record.scenario_id,
+        "symbol": record.symbol,
+        "mode": record.mode,
+        "execution_mode": record.execution_mode,
+        "condition": ProtectionCondition.OFFLINE if offline else record.condition,
+        "stale": offline,
+        "broker_order_id": record.broker_order_id,
+        "client_order_id": record.client_order_id,
+        "protected_qty": record.protected_qty,
+        "remaining_position_qty": record.remaining_position_qty,
+        "stop_price": record.stop_price,
+        "limit_price": record.limit_price,
+        "trail_price": record.trail_price,
+        "trail_percent": record.trail_percent,
+        "broker_hwm": record.broker_hwm,
+        "tif": record.tif,
+        "last_broker_confirmed_at": record.last_broker_confirmed_at,
+        "revision": record.revision,
+        "reason": record.reason if not offline else record.reason or "ENGINE_OFFLINE",
+    }
